narrative.intro: Humana Government Business has $5.6B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Humana Government Business received 2 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $2.8B. Obligations fell 13.5% year over year. Yearly obligations show a peak at $8B in FY24, followed by $6.5B in FY25 and $5.6B in FY26. Earlier fiscal years range from $7.1B in FY21 to $7.7B in FY22 and $7.8B in FY23. The current-year total is a partial fiscal-year figure, so the FY2026 to date number reflects obligations booked so far in the fiscal cycle. Contract activity this year centers on a small number of very large awards, given the 2-award count and the $2.8B average award size. Contract managers and capture teams should note the concentration of dollars into a low award count, and procurement analysts should reference the fiscal-year series when comparing current obligations to prior years.
